name: dreamframe-bedtime
title: DreamFrame Ambient Bedtime Story
description: A personalized, cinematic bedtime wind-down composition. Features an ambient room backdrop with Ken Burns camera panning, celestial glassmorphic badges, mood indicators, and a three-stage poetic narrative fade (The Settling Room, Sensory Atmosphere, Drifting into Sleep).

variables.label: Scene 1: The Settling Room
variables.default: The cursor blinks slower now. The last build succeeded, and the quiet room wraps around the screen's soft glow.

variables.label: Scene 2: Sensory Atmosphere
variables.default: Rain taps a steady rhythm against cold window glass. Steam rises faintly from an evening mug, cooling with the night.

variables.label: Scene 3: Drifting into Sleep
variables.default: Keyboards sleep. Shadows soften into stillness. Let the thoughts untangle as sleep pulls the curtain shut.
